summary: Verified new /api/analytics/* admin dashboard endpoints and DELETE /api/auth/me (store compliance), plus the ported Gracefy Admin Dashboard UI. Backend: 21/21 pytest passing (test_analytics_and_delete.py). All 6 analytics endpoints return 200 with correct shapes for admin: /overview (all keys incl currency=TZS), /trends (user_growth len=6, donations_trend len=6, content_performance), /user-demographics (device/gender/age/location), /realtime (all timestamp+counters), /download-stats (null accepted since no downloads seeded — matches spec), /live-listeners (top_playing_now list, timestamp). Access gating verified: unauthenticated -> 401/403, non-admin -> 403. DELETE /api/auth/me: regular user delete flow works — /me returns 401 after, subsequent login returns 401; admin self-delete returns 403; unauthenticated delete returns 401/403. Frontend (390x844 mobile viewport): admin login (Vibe@2026) succeeds, /admin renders header (admin-menu + admin-back), 3 segment tabs (Dashboard/Content/Users), live streaming banner ('Live 0 active listeners · 0 guest visitors · 0 plays today · 8 new users · 0 txns today'), 4 primary stat cards (Total Users 47/46 customers, Total Songs 36/8 albums, Churches 3/0 leaders, Total Raised TZS 8,000/16 campaigns), 4 secondary stats (Customers 46, System Users 1, Religious Leaders 0, Pending Approvals 0), all four chart sections (Customer Growth, Donations Trend, Content Performance, Category Distribution) and User Demographics section rendered — no red screen, no console errors (only harmless RN-Web props.pointerEvents deprecation warning). Tab switching (admin-tab-overview/content/users) works. Drawer opens on admin-menu, drawer-close hides it, menu-content switches to content tab (admin-add-album visible). Delete Account flow on Profile: modal opens on profile-delete-account tap, cancel closes it, confirm deletes the account (post: Mgeni text + profile-login button shown), and API confirms creds return 401. Everything working as spec.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warns: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking, likely coming from a library (react-native-gifted-charts or expo-linear-gradient). Reference: seen across /admin, /(auth)/login and (tabs) screens.

action_items: Optional cleanup: menu-overview testID appears 4x (Dashboard/Analytics/Revenue/Transactions all -> overview) and menu-users appears 2x — testing works via .first, but consider unique testIDs like menu-<label-slug> for individual-row targeting (already noted in iteration_11).
critical_code_review_comments: analytics.py _month_bounds uses now - timedelta(days=30*i) then .replace(day=1) — for i>=1 this can occasionally miss a month boundary when the current day is early in a 31-day month. Minor: buckets remain 6 rows and labels are correct, but if strict month alignment is required consider relativedelta.

analytics.py aggregates .to_list(10000) on transactions/users could become expensive as data grows; fine for current seed volume but consider moving to a $group pipeline for total_raised and demographics.
admin/index.tsx (711 lines) is approaching the 700-line soft limit; consider extracting DashboardOverview and chart subcomponents into /admin/components/*.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral TEST_del_* and TEST_selfdel_* users created inside tests; UI flow registered TEST_ui_* and deleted it via the Delete Account button.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New analytics router at /api/analytics/{overview,trends,user-demographics,realtime,download-stats,live-listeners} — all admin-only. /download-stats intentionally returns JSON null when downloads collection is empty; the UI banner hides in that case. DELETE /api/auth/me is the store-compliance endpoint (customers only; admins blocked with 403). Admin dashboard UI is fully working with real seeded data. Regression: use test_analytics_and_delete.py + existing test_admin_access.py.
